svg.text: Label flexes; icon stays I1. Start / end / none.
Panel is padding-free; inner box owns spacing.
Plain has no surface. Card adds shadow, no border.
Custom icon slot does not rotate automatically.
W, content height and parent gap are caller-owned.
Demo adds G and overrides content top to zero.
Schematic footprint · light token · see table
Scale 1:1 · inset padding cancels at start edge
Scale 5:1 · B = 0 · shadow is not a border
OPEN: h = measured → auto; overflow visible once settled.
CLOSE: h → 0; margin start OR end → −G in a flex column.
Inner opacity → 0; blur → F1. Grid gap is not compensated.
Reduced motion: D1 and D2 → 1ms; layout still reaches zero.
SOURCE: COLLAPSIBLE.TSX + VARIANTS · GLOBAL TOKENS · LIVE DEMO MEASURED
